method: Built-in image_gen edits; sharp for deterministic export sizes and formats.
scope: Only blue tones in app icon/logo; no website CSS or Android UI theme changes.

prompts.icon: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: existing LunarPing square app icon, color refinement only. Input image 1 is the edit target. Recolor ONLY the existing electric blue, cyan and violet-blue areas to a calmer, sophisticated, softly desaturated slate-blue/steel-blue family. Aim for silver-blue highlights around #9BAFBE, dusty steel-blue midtones around #58758D, deep muted blue around #2F485F, and a restrained charcoal-navy background around #101A25. Keep subtle gradient depth and crisp readable edges; reduce the neon/candy saturation and blue bloom. Preserve the EXACT original emblem shape, silhouette, crescent width, curved horizon geometry, lower pin point, scale, position, padding, star locations and star shapes. Keep the warm golden-yellow sun, orange warmth and gold horizon highlights unchanged. Keep white stars white. Do not redesign, add or remove any part. Do not add texture, text, rounded corners, borders, shadows outside the icon, mockup or presentation canvas. Return only the complete opaque full-bleed square icon at high resolution. This is a strictly color-only edit of an established logo, not a new logo.
prompts.foreground: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent Android adaptive launcher foreground. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET; Image 2 is a COLOR PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Change ONLY the electric cyan/blue/indigo pigments of Image 1 to exactly match Image 2's calm desaturated steel-blue/slate-blue treatment: silver-blue highlights, muted dusty steel-blue midtones, dark charcoal-navy interior, subtle restrained blue glow. Preserve Image 1's EXACT existing silhouette, crescent width, star positions and shapes, curved horizon geometry, lower tapered pin shape, alignment, scale, padding, edge quality and composition. Keep all the golden sun, orange warmth, gold horizon highlights and white stars unchanged. The full canvas outside Image 1's existing emblem must remain genuinely alpha transparent. Keep the dark internal sky enclosed by the crescent and horizon as part of the artwork; do not remove it. NO background tile, no square, no rounded corners, no added matte, no text, no new objects, no redesign, no silhouette changes. Output only the complete recolored transparent foreground with the same generous transparent padding as Image 1.
prompts.cleanup: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided transparent LunarPing launcher emblem. Small technical cleanup ONLY. Remove the stray white blob above the crescent at the very top and all tiny cyan, purple, red and white fringe specks OUTSIDE the smooth main emblem silhouette around the crescent and pin. Produce one perfectly clean, smoothly antialiased transparent silhouette. Preserve the existing muted steel-blue palette, all interior gradients, all stars and star positions, the exact crescent/pin/horizon shapes, the warm golden sun, composition, position, size and transparent padding. Do not redraw or redesign the emblem. Do not remove the intentional central white star or any interior stars. No background, no matte, no shadow, no text. Outside the smooth edge of the actual emblem must be truly fully transparent, including the isolated speck above it.
